sentences.en: The Sioux tribe asked the government to enforce the treaty.
sentences.zh: Sioux 部落要求政府执行条约。

sentences.en: The supervisor enforced the rules here in this factory.
sentences.zh: 监督者强制工厂里的规章制度。

sentences.en: The new law was enforced on the people of the island.
sentences.zh: 新法在岛民中开始实施。

senses.zh: 实施, 执行强迫, 迫使
